exercise.prompt:
Build a number pyramid. Read N.
1. Print N rows. Row 1 is `1`, row 2 is `1 2`, row 3 is `1 2 3`, and so on: the numbers separated by single spaces, with no space at the end.
2. Then print `Sum:` and the total of every number you printed.
Hint: build each row as a string with an f-string, starting from `"1"`.
exercise.promptHi:
Ek number pyramid banao. N padho.
1. N rows print karo. Row 1 hai `1`, row 2 hai `1 2`, row 3 hai `1 2 3`, aur aise hi aage: numbers single spaces se alag, aakhir mein koi space nahi.
2. Phir `Sum:` aur jo bhi numbers print kiye unka total print karo.
Hint: har row ko f-string se string ki tarah banao, `"1"` se shuru karke.
exercise.starterCode: # Read N, then print the rows and the sum
